title: Martin LLP
description: martinllp.net Martin LLP Martin LLP is a boutique business law firm founded in 1996, with offices in Stamford and New York. It focuses on middle-market companies, private equity sponsors, lenders, and business owners. Core practices: M&A and private equity, banking and finance, commercial litigation, and commercial real estate. The firm positions itself as partner-led, with small teams and senior lawyers doing hands-on work on deals from a few million to several hundred million dollars. Its people come from large national firms like Skadden, Latham & Watkins, Mayer Brown, and Schulte Roth. It publishes actively on M&A topics, notably representation and warranty insurance (RWI). It is recognized in regional rankings such as Best Law Firms 2026 for Corporate Law in Stamford.
